title: M5.5: Phone verification and linking
description:
Member adds a number in the web app and enters a one-time SMS code; a number links to one member in one organization at a time; SMS-linked members have the conversational grant only; guests off by default.

Acceptance criteria:
- Wrong or expired code does not link
- A number already linked elsewhere is refused with a neutral message
- Unlink and removal take effect at the next message

Gherkin: features/sms_phone_verification.feature

Depends on: M5.4

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
